Maria: Quick heads-up — launch on Monday 3/30. Need paid setup: search + retarget. Goal: 2.5% CVR, CPL <= $45. Who can own bids/dayparting?
Samir: I can own search bids. Proposal: start with max CPC $3, daily budget $1.5k split across core keywords. Daypart 9am-6pm PST for top cities. 
Leah: For retargeting, I recommend a creative refresh for 7–14 day window. Use 3 variants A/B/C and rotate every 48h. CPL target for retarget: $25. 
AJ: Routing question — where do inbound leads from search go? webhook to HubSpot form? 
Maria: Yes webhook -> HubSpot -> lead routing flow. Jamie, can you confirm mapping and scoring? here's the doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-paid-setup (pls don't share externally)
Jamie: Confirmed. Mapping: utm_source=paid, utm_medium=search|retarget; set lead_score>70 -> SDR queue. I'll attach routing rules later. 
Samir: Quick ask on measurement — is the pixel firing on the pricing page? 
Leah: @ops-bot just ran a tag check earlier, pixel on pricing and demo-thanks pages is live. 
ops-bot: Tag check results: pricing.html -> gtag fired, fb_pixel fired, conversions API queued. 
AJ: Budget pacing — we should allow 10% daily increase if volume lags first 48h. Set rule: if spend < 60% of forecast and clicks >5% higher, increase bid by 10% (caps apply). 
Maria: Love that. Samir, implement bid rule. Share snippet for GA/ads alerts.
Samir: Will do. Snippet for alerts: 
```
if(spend < forecast*0.6 && clicks > forecast_clicks*1.05) {
  increase_bids(10%);
}
```
Leah: Creative brief for refresh: focus on faster TTR, new CTAs (Book demo vs Learn more), include testimonial line. I'll drop assets to the creative drive by EOD. 
Jamie: Also enable lead dedupe: match by email + utm_campaign to avoid dupes from repeat clicks. 
Maria: TL;DR action items: Samir = implement search bids + pacing rule, Leah = assets + retarget creative test, Jamie = routing + dedupe, AJ = confirm HubSpot webhook and QA. We'll sync tomorrow 11:15am PT. :thumbsup:
Samir: Got it — will ping when rules live. 
AJ: I'll QA the webhook after mapping. 
Leah: Assets uploading now. 
Maria: Thanks team — last ask: keep an eye on quality score drop; if QS drops >10% pause low-performers. :eyes:
